description:
§17.6.10 / §10.1 — the MARKUP-VALUED instance of the value-form sugar. `ctrl-021` pins the sugar for a STRING branch; this case pins it for a branch that is exactly one MARKUP element, which under the §1.4 L1 pillar is an expression by the same rule that admits `"Admin"`. `#out-admin` takes the true branch and renders `

Admin

`, `#out-guest` the false branch and renders `

User

`, `#out-lift` writes the SAME shape with an explicit `lift` in each branch and renders identically (the equivalence §17.6.10 asserts), and `#out-noelse` pins the else-less form. The discriminator that makes this a distinct case from ctrl-021 is the branch's VALUE TYPE, not the control-flow form: the shape used to be accepted for a string branch and SILENTLY DROPPED for a markup one.
rationale:
§10.1 limb 2, as amended S391 (`provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S371 "value-form b"`): "an arm body that is exactly one expression carries an implied `lift` of that expression". §17.6.10: "A branch body that is exactly one expression SHALL be equivalent to `{ lift }`." §1.4 / §6097 (L1 pillar): "markup elements may sit anywhere expressions sit" — so a markup element IS such an expression and the two normative sentences reach it. Before S433 they did not describe the compiler: `${ if (@on) {

Yes

} else {

No

} }` rendered NOTHING at exit 0 with zero diagnostics (`g-if-arm-bare-markup-branch-silently-dropped`, HIGH, adopter-reported, routed S377), while the identical branches holding a string rendered and `{ lift

Yes

}` rendered. This case exists so the MARKUP limb of the sugar cannot regress independently of the string limb that ctrl-021 already pins — the defect was exactly such an independent regression, invisible to every case written over string branches. Note the sibling value-form `match` limb is deliberately NOT symmetric: a markup arm there is REJECTED by E-MATCH-ARM-MARKUP-IN-VALUE, because §18.0 splits the two `match` forms by output category and offers `` for the markup one. §17.6 carries no such split for `if`, which is why the `if` limb accepts. No diagnostic is expected: the form is valid.
